This article examines the distribution of CHA2DS2VASc scores among prevalent atrial fibrillation patients who developed intracranial bleeding across [[danmark|Danmark]] and its five administrative regions. The CHA2DS2VASc score is a clinical tool used to estimate stroke risk in patients with atrial fibrillation, and analyzing these scores in patients who subsequently suffered an intracranial hemorrhage provides critical insight into the risk profiles of this vulnerable population. Because the available data consists of a single snapshot from 2024, no longitudinal trends can be established.

Nationally, there were 733 total cases of intracranial bleeding among this patient group [^src1]. [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] accounted for the highest volume of cases with 212 patients, while [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] recorded the fewest with 82 patients [^src1]. Across the country, a CHA2DS2VASc score of 1 was the most common, representing 36.3% of the national cohort, closely followed by a score of 2 at 34.7% [^src1].

Regional variations reveal distinct risk distributions. [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] had the highest proportion of patients with a score of 1 (47.0%), but conversely recorded the lowest proportions of patients with scores of 3 (14.5%) and 4 (3.0%) [^src1]. In contrast, [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] showed the highest concentrations of patients with moderate-to-higher risk scores, leading the regions in the proportion of patients scoring 2 (43.5%) and 4 (7.4%) [^src1]. 

Patients with the highest risk score recorded in the dataset (a score of 5) were exceptionally rare. [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] reported the highest percentage at 1.2% (with the exact count suppressed), followed by [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] at 0.6% [^src1]. Meanwhile, [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]], [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]], and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] reported zero patients with a score of 5 [^src1]. For the lowest risk category (a score of 0), [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] (6.6%) and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] (6.1%) had the highest shares, whereas [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] and [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] had the lowest at 3.6% [^src1].
